items.quote: Provide the number of removed outliers.
items.description: 答案檔必須包含 @removed_outliers_count 項，值為非負整數。

items.quote: Identify and remove any outliers in the "row retention time" column using the Z-score method with a Z-score threshold of 3.
items.description: 以母體標準差計算 row retention time 欄位的 Z-score，|z|>3 的資料點即為離群值，其個數應與答案檔 @removed_outliers_count 一致。

items.quote: Any data point with a Z-score greater than 3 or less than -3 is considered an outlier and should be removed.
items.description: Z-score > 3 或 < -3 的資料點計為離群值並移除；移除數量與答案檔值重算比對（zcount3 即 |z|>3 計數）。

items.quote: The data file for this task is `data/imp.score.ldlr.metabolome.csv`.
items.description: 重算以 data/imp.score.ldlr.metabolome.csv 為輸入資料檔，且該檔案不得被更改。

items.quote: Write your final answer to `answer.txt` in the root of this workspace.
items.description: 最終答案須寫入工作區根目錄的 answer.txt，格式為 @removed_outliers_count[非負整數]。
